div.div:
BatteryMind — AI memory and retrieval pipeline
One chat request, from sign-in to stored memory. Structured measurements are always authoritative; vector search only chooses which earlier assessments to recall.

div.div:
1 · Authenticate and authorize
The API verifies the Cognito ID token signature, issuer, audience and expiry. The user id scopes every query.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(232, 241, 251), rgb(24, 32, 41)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(84, 91, 100), rgb(154, 160, 168));

div.div:
2 · Resolve battery and session
The session must belong to this user and to the requested battery; otherwise the request is refused (404).

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(232, 241, 251), rgb(24, 32, 41)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(84, 91, 100), rgb(154, 160, 168));

div.div:
3 · Retrieve authoritative evidence
Measured discharge capacity, derived SOH, deterministic decision and RUL come from structured data at the chosen cycle cutoff.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(232, 241, 251), rgb(24, 32, 41)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(84, 91, 100), rgb(154, 160, 168));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 322px; height: 1px; padding-top: 255px; margin-left: 1220px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #232F3E;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#232F3E, #bdc7d4); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
4 · Recall prior assessments
Embed the question, then pgvector cosine search over this user's valid assessments for the battery up to the cutoff (top 8), plus the 5 most recent.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(232, 241, 251), rgb(24, 32, 41)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(84, 91, 100), rgb(154, 160, 168));

div.div:
5 · Rank
score = 0.45 relevance + 0.25 recency + 0.20 importance + 0.10 confidence. Importance follows the decision severity.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(232, 241, 251), rgb(24, 32, 41)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(84, 91, 100), rgb(154, 160, 168));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 322px; height: 1px; padding-top: 485px; margin-left: 820px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #232F3E;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#232F3E, #bdc7d4); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
6 · Compress to budget
Evidence is kept in full; ranked memories are added until a 5,000-character context budget is reached.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(232, 241, 251), rgb(24, 32, 41)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(84, 91, 100), rgb(154, 160, 168));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 322px; height: 1px; padding-top: 485px; margin-left: 420px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #232F3E;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#232F3E, #bdc7d4); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
7 · Generate
Gemma 3 12B answers from the evidence block and the last 6 turns. Rules: label values measured, derived or predicted; cite assessment ids; refuse to invent numbers.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(232, 241, 251), rgb(24, 32, 41)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(84, 91, 100), rgb(154, 160, 168));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 322px; height: 1px; padding-top: 485px; margin-left: 20px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #232F3E;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#232F3E, #bdc7d4); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
8 · Store
Both turns are saved with model id, token counts and latency. New assessments are saved with their embedding for later recall.

div.div: Short-term — the last 6 chat turns of the session (chat_turns). Episodic — saved assessments with the cutoff, decision, policy version, evidence and validity (valid, superseded or deleted). Semantic — a 1,024-dimension Titan embedding per assessment in pgvector. Authoritative data — NASA measurements and calculated metrics in structured storage, never replaced by retrieved text. Per-user isolation is enforced twice: query filters and forced row-level security through a non-bypass database role.
